visual_identity.core_identity: A small wiry goblinoid scavenger with quick hands, oversized pointed ears, and an expressive sharp-featured face.
visual_identity.silhouette: Compact torso, thin limbs, slightly oversized head and ears, crouched or darting posture.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad pointed ears, short flattened nose, sharp chin, wide mouth with small teeth, prominent brows and lively eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Small narrow-chested humanoid with quick hands and feet; less reptilian and less muscular than a kobold or hobgoblin.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly smooth skin with minimal wrinkles or scars; no fur covering.
signature_gear: small scavenged knife or kitchen tool

accuracy_checks: face is goblinoid rather than reptilian

reference.notes: Reference guides goblin silhouette and facial anatomy only.
